translations.web: They all ate, and were filled. They took up twelve baskets full of that which remained left over from the broken pieces.
translations.bsb: They all ate and were satisfied, and the disciples picked up twelve basketfuls of broken pieces that were left over.
translations.kjv: And they did all eat, and were filled: and they took up of the fragments that remained twelve baskets full.
